title: Array copies and inout updates
summary: Contrast a local array copy with an explicit inout update to the caller. Arrays provide value semantics.
code: func appending(_ value: Int, to numbers: [Int]) -> [Int] {
func appendInPlace(_ value: Int, to numbers: inout [Int]) {
triggers: choose between returning an updated value and mutating the caller
prompts: Provide both a copying append and an append that updates a caller-owned array.
invariant: The copying function leaves its input unchanged; inout writes back to the caller.
mantra: Copy for a new value; use & for an explicit update.
pitfalls: Copy-on-write is an optimization and does not change array value semantics.
inout arguments require a mutable variable and an ampersand.
